title: Effects of Recorded Music on Clinical and EEG Seizure Activity
official: Effects of Recorded Music on Clinical and Electroencephalography (EEG) Seizure Activity
summary: This research is being done to determine if Mozart music and/or age-appropriate music can reduce the frequency of seizures and epileptiform discharges.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children (age: 4 - 17 years old) who stay at Epilepsy Monitoring Units (EMU) up to 7 days may join.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English Speaking
